segments.text: Alex Rivera: The Redis timeout issue is now fully resolved. I implemented a circuit breaker using the tenacity library and configured exponential backoff. The fix was deployed on September 3rd.
Kiran Das: The Kubernetes cluster is set up and the staging environment is running on it. However, we discovered a new issue: pod startup times are exceeding 30 seconds due to large Docker images.
Rahul Verma: We decided to switch our NLP caching strategy from write-through to write-behind to reduce latency. This modifies the original Redis caching decision from the kickoff meeting.
Alex Rivera: Kiran Das is assigned to optimize the Docker images. Target: reduce image size by 60 percent. Deadline is September 12th.
